title: Team Members
statement: Implement `solve(left_add, right_add)`. Two teams are created with default empty member lists that must not be shared. Append `left_add` to the first team if it is not the empty string. Append `right_add` to the second the same way. Return `{"left": [...], "right": [...]}`. An empty string means no append for that side.
constraints: The default list is created per instance
The teams do not share members
hints: Use a fresh list for each team. default_factory is the dataclass tool. A function-local list() is the same idea.
Append only when the string is non-empty.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: A dataclass default of [] is shared by every instance, the same bug as a class attribute.

editorial: A dataclass default of [] is shared by every instance, the same bug as a class attribute. default_factory=list builds a new list per instance. After one append each, the two lists differ. A shared default would show both names on both teams.
